scan.scope: Every .ts/.tsx/.json under client/src,server,shared; all runtime route/API/export/legacy-description source, shipped publication records and comments. Every occurrence records exact file,line,span start,text,local context,classification and reason. No file/route whitelist.
scan.exceptionPolicy: Each nontrivial exception is one exact file plus complete whitespace-normalized literal/comment/JSX text and an individual reason. Covers actual negation, CAT/NGFS published scenario scope, policy-coverage indicator definitions, proper publisher names, news keywords and technical trace documentation. Changed or unused exceptions fail tests. Technical code/test attributes are inventoried, not presented as numeric quantity labels.
scan.mutationTests: Reject5%baseline-is-net-zero, contextual5Gt Net Zero Year, one negated occurrence followed by a positive occurrence, unrelated unavailable prose and double-negation is-not-unavailable. Unqualified Net Zero Year is unknown, not silently accepted.
unknownCoverage: Two HTTP registration sites are templated; exact source expressions are inventoried, not falsely reported as expanded route counts.
Arbitrary runtime concatenations, external article/provider strings, database rows and opaque historical JSON are not exhaustively executed by a static source scan.
Built/minified release artifacts and unrelated operator/study CLI exports are not reverified here.
No browser hover/click/portal verification or every-field/every-state component coverage is inferred.
